1.Name: Sonata Note Issue 1
1.Description: A source of lyrical music that can be acquired by purchasing bundles other than Growth Bundles, Alpinist's Bundles, Climber's Bundles, Apex Bundle, subscriptions, and Noble Privileges during Melodic Gifts. Players who accumulate a certain number of Sonata Notes in a day will receive a Precious Record. They are cleared at the start of each day. This item can only be used during corresponding issues in Melodic Gifts.
